note: DataTables provides a Views style plugin (id 'datatables', class extends core Table, theme views_view_datatables) plus one site config object datatables.settings.use_cdn (form at /admin/config/services/datatables, permission 'administer site configuration'). Per-view configuration lives in the view config under display.*.display_options.style.type = datatables (schema views.style.datatables). Config-object cases (use_cdn) are fully agent-completable; the view cases are grounded in the views.view config entity and read via the view storage. The view fixtures/builds use raw config writes because Views config-entity saves via the entity/Views API are currently blocked by an unrelated broken commerce_giftcard field on this shared site.

evals.prompt: How do I make a Drupal Views table use the jQuery DataTables plugin (searchable, sortable, paginated) with the datatables module?
evals.expected_output: Build a view with fields, then set the display's Format/style to 'DataTables' (the datatables Views style plugin, id 'datatables', which extends core's Table style). The client-side DataTables plugin then adds search, column sorting and pagination.

evals.prompt: The datatables module needs the DataTables JavaScript library. What are my two options for providing it, and which setting controls that?
evals.expected_output: Either install the DataTables library locally under /libraries (e.g. via Asset Packagist) or load it from a CDN. The datatables.settings config object's 'use_cdn' boolean (form at /admin/config/services/datatables, permission 'administer site configuration') switches between local (false) and CDN (true).

evals.prompt: What kinds of interactive features can I toggle on a DataTables-style view in Drupal (search, pagination, etc.)?
evals.expected_output: The style options include a search filter box, a table-info line, state saving, TableTools (copy/print/export), pagination style and page length, per-column sortable/align/separator/hide-empty, hidden and expandable columns, and per-column search/filter types.

evals.prompt: On this site, is the DataTables library being loaded from a CDN or from the local libraries folder? Inspect the live configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: The datatables.settings config object has use_cdn = true, so the DataTables library is loaded from the CDN. Read with `drush cget datatables.settings use_cdn`.

evals.prompt: One view on this site is configured to render with the DataTables style. Inspect the live view configuration and give the machine name of that view.
evals.expected_output: The view dt_known uses the DataTables style: in views.view.dt_known its default display has display_options.style.type = datatables.

evals.prompt: Configure this site so the DataTables JavaScript library is loaded from the CDN rather than the local libraries folder. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set datatables.settings use_cdn = true (tick 'Use CDN' at /admin/config/services/datatables, or set the config value). Clearing the library discovery cache afterwards applies it.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a view named dt_task whose display renders using the DataTables style (the datatables Views style plugin). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a view (views.view.dt_task) with a display whose display_options.style.type = datatables (i.e. Format = DataTables).
